# Shubhakamna.in

> Bharat ka paavan shubhakamna portal for personalized festival wishes, 3D greeting cards, and devotional status maker.

## Core Features & Pages
- [Home & Festival Wishes](https://www.shubhakamna.in/): Create personalized festive greeting cards with your name and photo for Diwali, New Year, Holi, Rakshabandhan, and more.
- [Shubh Prabhat Suvichar](https://www.shubhakamna.in/shubh-prabhat): Daily motivational suvichar and morning cards with 3D embossed Devanagari typography.
- [Birthday Surprises](https://www.shubhakamna.in/birthday): Custom birthday wishing cards with music and photo.
- [Devotional Katha & Vrat](https://www.shubhakamna.in/katha): Sacred Kathas and aartis with floating audio player.

## Optional Data & APIs
- [Sitemap](https://www.shubhakamna.in/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for search crawlers.
- [Site Data](https://www.shubhakamna.in/site-data.json): Festival and celebration metadata repository.
